name: Carelessness
overview: Scripture warns against carelessness by emphasizing the importance of diligent meditation on God's law to ensure wise and prosperous living, as seen in Joshua 1:8. Carelessness in spiritual matters leads to blindness and downfall, illustrated by Jesus' warning about blind leaders in Matthew 15:14. Additionally, Isaiah 53:1 challenges the acceptance of false reports or doctrines, while Galatians 1:8 sternly condemns any deviation from the true gospel, underscoring the necessity of careful adherence to God's revealed truth.
